import json, os, System, Rhino, scriptcontext as sc
root = 'C:/Users/08432.SINOLTD/00.DEVE/31.AEC/RHINO_Deve/EnvironmentalSimulationHub'
evidence = os.path.join(root, 'docs/evidence/webview_0108')
assert System.Diagnostics.Process.GetCurrentProcess().Id == 25488
